scope: All source-backed full-record field groups; active-record samples only, not every record or aggregate/search endpoint
methodology: Missing historical dates are omitted; dates use ISO date-only format. Class lists follow '; ' source separators. Peak IDs are database identifiers, not source values. Peak order and decimal numeric equality are preserved, without rounding tolerance. Within differences, 'old' means source and 'new' means the API response. This is not a full-field or exhaustive-record audit. AUTHORS text is reconstructed by comma-joining name entries with any structured MARC roles; roles are also checked separately. COMMENT objects are reconstructed into source lines. Optional absent fields are compared with empty containers/text. Arrays preserve order and duplicates; order-only differences are reported separately, not silently normalized. A subtag/value boundary difference with identical reconstructed source lines is marked text-preserving, rather than treated as data loss; legacy subtags can contain spaces. Annotation columns are transposed to source rows; only their m/z column is numeric. Unknown source tags are reported, not ignored. Peak IDs and derived neutral-loss output have no direct source field and are excluded; absent AC$GENERAL/AC$ION_MOBILITY data is not positive coverage.
caveat: The local snapshot may be newer than the deployed release; source mismatches require checking the deployed raw-text record before attributing them to conversion.
